events.text: Austria has started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: Sun God (+1 [ICON_FOOD] Food for each [ICON_RES_WHEAT] Wheat, Banana, [ICON_RES_CITRUS] Citrus, [ICON_RES_COCOA] Cocoa, and [ICON_RES_PINEAPPLE] Pineapple resource)

Morocco has started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: Merchants' Trail (+1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production and +2 [ICON_GOLD] Gold from [ICON_BUILDING_CARAVANSARY] Caravansaries)

Venice has started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: Voice of the Surf (+1 [ICON_PEACE] Faith and +1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture from Atolls, and from [ICON_RES_FISH] Fish, [ICON_RES_WHALE] Whales, [ICON_RES_CRAB] Crab, [ICON_RES_PEARLS] Pearls, Red Caviar, and Caviar resources)
Egypt has started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: Warband Forge (+1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production and +2 [ICON_GOLD] Gold from [ICON_BUILDING_BARRACKS] Barracks)
Sweden has started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: Oral Tradition (+1 [ICON_PEACE] Faith from Plantation Resources)
The Inca have started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: Sacred Waters (+1 [ICON_HAPPINESS_1] Happiness and +1 [ICON_GOLD] Gold from cities on fresh water)
A golden age begins for the Venetian civilization.
